name: Sergeant Jory Vale
description: Adult human woman, thirties; Dragon Knight rear-party sergeant supervising packing at Vantt's waterside landing after Hanzo's departure. Plain mail, rolled blanket over shoulder, cropped dark hair. Not the provisioning corporal or Vask.

extras.current_assignment: Supervise last loads at Vantt landing; departure not yet complete
extras.unknowns: Halla's guard trial and Ward's orders; ownership of each disputed item not fixed
extras.luck_policy: PC-only campaign rule: NPCs have no Luck pool or Luck rank bonuses; never spend Luck for NPC rerolls, reversals or damage mitigation.
extras.rewind_note: Introduced in discarded later timeline; no current scene or knowledge.

actor_notes: LOOKS: Cropped dark hair, plain mail, sleeves rolled over gauntlet straps; blanket carried for departure. CORE: A working sergeant who wants her remaining soldiers and kit safely away, and believes an unanswerable order is a problem passed down to her. NATURE: Brisk, tired, practical, no pleasure in frightening civilians. WANTS: Finish loading and leave without being made personally liable for the company's unpaid bills. PRESSURE: Stops movement long enough to demand a clear responsible officer; if threatened orders shields together, not an automatic attack. SPEECH: Short concrete working orders, asks people their business directly, no jokes or legal speeches. Knows neither Halla's private appointment nor Ward's instructions and does not automatically recognise every guild's property.
